evidence.reason: The implementation substitutes the escaped instance name for both %i and %I. systemd defines %i as the escaped instance and %I as the unescaped instance, so a unit such as ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket with Service=%I.service resolves to crq-tick.service, while this scan produces crq\x2dtick.service and misses the dependency. The fix is to apply systemd unit-name unescaping only when replacing %I, leaving %i as the escaped instance. This is an existing correctness defect in the dependency scan, not a new requirement.
